prompt: The deploy.py helper distributes skill directories, including their references. Our build normalizes every file timestamp to 1 second after the epoch. After a reference changes to different text of the same byte length, deployment reports success but a reader still sees the old text. Fix the helper and verify that both SKILL.md and bundled references refresh. Preserve the command interface: python3 deploy.py SOURCE TARGET. This is a synthetic local filesystem task; do not access real agent directories or the network.

evaluation.scope: Local deployment with fixed timestamps and equal-size content changes; no Nix or real agent dependency.

rubric.criterion: Deployment refreshes complete skill contents even when byte length and timestamp do not change.
